marginal_gate_rationale: An extra forest needs at least +.0005 beyond the better component before final-role consideration; a tiny +.0002 improvement has low complexity value. This extra criterion is fixed before combined predictions are formed.
screen: Use matching preexisting 3000-series component screen OOFs and the original fixed admission threshold. No full-CV entry after a failed screen.
authority: After the late-phase time gate, retain all three weights; no continuous optimization or weight selection using seal/reduced/public evidence.

candidates.hypothesis: Memory-retaining V007 gains more on scale/mixed breaks; memory-removed Q005 gains on dependence and some H regimes. Fixed averaging may reduce their observed complementary errors.
candidates.change: Two frozen learners share their identical causal feature bank; float32-quantize each probability before the fixed float64 average and final float32 cast.
candidates.risk: Adaptive DEV nomination; shared training data and feature bank limit independent evidence. Reject marginal improvements that do not justify a second forest.
